key_points: HP warned that PC unit volumes will fall by a mid‑single‑digit percentage in 2027 due to rising costs.
Despite beating Q2 estimates, HP lowered its FY26 guidance, signaling weaker forward outlook.
Rising memory and component costs are dampening consumer PC demand (UBS).
Morgan Stanley notes HP’s multi‑year valuation highs do not reflect unit and margin pressures.
State Street Corp holds $1.17 bn in HPQ, indicating institutional interest but not a catalyst.
